Year-round rhythm

For homeschool, private-school Bible class, co-op, church kids club, or the family table (ages 5–18): one gentle day at a time. No account is required to read; progress stays on each device and works offline after the first visit.

School-year months (August first)—each tile is a calm hint for the season; tap any month to jump to the memory grid and cards below.

Memory verses (calendar year)

One anchor verse per month in the KJV—gentle review on this device only. Mark “learning” or celebrate “memorized” on the Family hub; this grid lists the same verses. Weekly: say one aloud. Summer (June–July): one or two a week is plenty.

Printable cut-out cards: Church kit — Memory Verse Cards. One-page print: Year at a glance (all months + seasonal doors + gentle activity reminders). Activity ideas (no quizzes): Gentle Memory Verse Activities · print sheet. Trackers: Printable planners (also church kit).

Month Reference Verse (short) Status on device

Pin any Battle Plan day to this list: open Battle Plans and tap Pin to Memory Verses on a day card.

How to use this page

  • School year (about August–May): steady Mon–Fri bites from a kids plan; one midweek check-in on family.html for progress on a shared device.
  • Summer (about June–July): fewer days per week, shorter sits, more outside—still KJV on the screen.
  • Holidays: named doors below link to plans you already have; use them when the calendar asks for focus, not because you “owe” God a program.

Weekly + daily curriculum map (ages 5–18)

Use one shared Scripture theme across the whole group, then scale the response by age. Keep it calm: read the KJV verse, use one small step, and close with one honest prayer.

Age band Daily rhythm (10–15 min) Weekly rhythm (45–75 min total) Suggested track
5–7 Read one short verse line aloud twice, one story picture or motion, one sentence prayer. 3 short days (Mon/Wed/Fri) + one gentle review circle. Lord’s Prayer for Kids or Beatitudes for Kids
8–10 Read full day card, answer one question in their own words, write or draw one takeaway. 4 days (Mon–Thu) + Friday recap verse and prayer pair. Sower for Kids + Summer Seeds in June/July
11–13 Read day card, write one journal line, choose one practice step (kindness, apology, service, or prayer). 4–5 days + one discussion block where students explain the verse in plain words. Beatitudes for Kids then Peacemakers
14–18 Read day card and verse context, write one application line, close with one intercession for school/friends. 5 days + one weekly reflection huddle (what changed this week?). Lord’s Prayer, Beatitudes, or Sermon on the Mount intro

Multi-age class tip: keep everyone on the same weekly theme, then split response time by age (draw, discuss, journal). Printable support: week tracker and planner worksheets.

Teacher Pack — one-page scope and sequence

Run one coherent flow across classroom, co-op, or church team in 45–60 minutes. Keep Scripture central, then scale the response by age. Print this section or save to PDF.

Lesson block Timing What to do Age adjustment
Warm start5 minOpen with one KJV verse and one short story hook.5–10: echo phrase; 11–18: read full verse aloud.
Understanding12–15 minRead day card, then ask one observation and one meaning question.5–10: picture response; 11–18: one journal line.
Practice step10 minChoose one concrete action (kindness, apology, gratitude, service).5–10: group action; 11–18: individual commitment.
Prayer close5 minPray one sentence from the verse and one intercession.Younger: repeat-after-leader; older: volunteer prayers.
Home handoff3 minSend verse + one practice line to caregivers.Use printable cards in handoff cards.

Monthly lesson sheets (12-month set)

Each month gives one focus verse, one teaching aim, one activity, and one prayer close. Use these as a repeatable spine for private Christian schools, co-ops, or church teams.

August

Focus: courage in transition (Joshua 1:9). Activity: backpack prayer tags. Close: courage prayer before school starts.

September

Focus: Lord's Prayer phrases. Activity: line-by-line echo prayer. Close: one sentence thanksgiving.

October

Focus: gratitude rhythms (Psalm 100:4). Activity: thankful table cards. Close: family thank-you prayer.

November

Focus: praise and remembrance. Activity: gratitude chain links. Close: spoken praise around the room.

December

Focus: Advent hope (Luke 2:10-11). Activity: simple nativity verse card. Close: Christ-centered peace prayer.

January

Focus: new mercies (Lamentations 3:22-23). Activity: reset journal line. Close: prayer for steady beginnings.

February

Focus: heart soil (Sower). Activity: four soils visual chart. Close: ask God for receptive hearts.

March

Focus: repentance and trust. Activity: one turn-back-to-God step. Close: humble confession prayer.

April

Focus: resurrection hope. Activity: empty-tomb reading prompts. Close: prayer of hope and joy.

May

Focus: family encouragement. Activity: blessing words for home. Close: prayer for parents and caregivers.

June

Focus: summer stillness. Activity: verse walk outdoors. Close: be-still breath prayer.

July

Focus: perseverance in heat and travel. Activity: one-verse memory check. Close: keep-us-steady prayer.

Full print companion: Church kit planner sheets.

Parent handoff cards (printable)

Cut and send these home so caregivers can reinforce the same verse and step in one minute. Keep wording short and calm.

Card 1 — What we learned

This week: God is with us in fear. Verse: Joshua 1:9. Ask your child to say one phrase they remember.

Card 2 — One small step

Practice this week: speak one kind sentence before dinner each day. Keep it simple and specific.

Card 3 — Prayer line

Pray together: “Lord, help our family trust Thee this week. Amen.”

Card 4 — Keep going

Next week opens here: Beatitudes for Kids. One short day is enough.

School-year week (example)

Swap studies when you finish one; repeat years if you like. All links open the same gentle day cards as everywhere else on the site.

  • Monday–Tuesday–Thursday: one day per session from Lord’s Prayer for Kids, Beatitudes for Kids, or Parable of the Sower for Kids (pick one track per term, or rotate).
  • Wednesday: Family hub — glance at progress, pray one sentence together, optional Family Worship in the Trenches day.
  • Friday: light review (favorite verse from the week) or a hands-on idea from Church kit crafts / prayer activities — no quiz required.

Older students beside you: the same week’s theme in an adult plan (for example Lord’s Prayer or Beatitudes) can follow the kids day.

Summer Seeds (lighter weeks)

Quiet summer with Jesus — aim for three short visits a week (about 3–5 minutes), not seven.

Eight-week spine: Summer Seeds for Kids — one KJV anchor day per week beside a grown-up; progress saves on this device like your other Battle Plans.

Optional second habit: whisper one phrase from each week’s verse at breakfast. The monthly memory grid below lists a full verse per month if you want a gentle parallel track—never required.

Optional deeper rotation (same summer, if you want more pages open):

  • Weeks 1–2: Beatitudes for Kids at half pace.
  • Weeks 3–4: Lord’s Prayer for Kids.
  • Weeks 5–6: Sower for Kids plus a real seed in a cup (water together; pray a one-line thanks).
  • Weeks 7–8: free-choice review or five restful days from 7-Day Peace (stop when five days feel complete).

Optional rhythm: Monday — one study day · Wednesday — family devotion on family.html · Friday — story or craft; other days optional.

Holidays & seasonal doors

More context and alternates: Seasonal paths.

  • Back to school: Back-to-School Courage (seven days) · 7-Day Peace · Worry to Trust · Seasonal — back to school.
  • Harvest / thanks: Harvest Gratitude (seven days) · any week in 30-Day Praise & Thanksgiving.
  • Advent / Christmas: Advent Quiet (seven days) · Christmas Week — Christ the Light.
  • New Year: New Year Week — Steady Mercies · Gentle New Year Reset (five short days).
  • Easter: He is risen readings · Resurrection Hope (seven-day plan) — prominent doorway in spring.
  • Summer: Summer Stillness (five days) · Summer Seeds for Kids (eight-week spine).

Unit-style bundles (mix and match)

  • Kingdom living (~9 weeks at one day/week): Beatitudes for Kids → Sermon on the Mount intro (on the plans page) for older listeners → Sower for Kids.
  • Prayer journey (~7 weeks): Lord’s Prayer for Kids with Lord’s Prayer for teens or parents on the same evenings.
  • Heart soil (summer-friendly): Sower for Kids plus a paper “four soils” drawing; jot one sentence after a walk (“What did God make that reminded you of Him?”).

Private school, chapel, or Bible class

One fifteen-minute block weekly: open the day on a projector or tablet, read the KJV verse aloud, read the short reflection, do the small step (whisper, draw, or kindness), pray the printed prayer. Leader notes and copy for families: Children’s ministry leader guide and Volunteer training on the Church Sharing Kit.
